english.title: Prohibition by magistrates' order on allowing sale of alcohol on train / station - Licensing
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) knowingly allowed the sale of alcohol, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ALCOHOL..), in contravention of an order made by **(..SPECIFY THE MAGISTRATES' COURT..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE OF ORDER..) under section 157 of the Licensing Act 2003 prohibiting such sale on any railway vehicle

(A)_[at **(..SPECIFY THE STATION..) railway station]_
(B)_[at **(..SPECIFY THE STATIONS..) railway stations]_
(C)_[travelling between **(..SPECIFY THE STATIONS TRAVELLED BETWEEN..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 157(5)(b) and (6) of the Licensing Act 2003.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
knowingly allowed the sale of alcohol
in contravention of an order made by a magistrates' court
prohibiting such a sale
on any railway vehicle
at a railway station/stations or
travelling between certain stations

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 157(2) provides that a magistrates' court may make an order under this section only on the application of a senior police officer.
(ii) At least one of the railway stations specified in the order MUST be within the petty sessional area of the magistrates' court making the order.

other.penalty:
Three months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding twenty thousand pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions:
12 months
